integrity: Proof is self-contained; a standalone Python checker supplements rather than replaces the infinite argument. No authorship, independent certification, or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula concerns only length 2^k dyadic prefixes, k>=2, of the powers-of-two indicator word. It does not classify all minimum attractors or non-dyadic prefixes. The matching upper bound already follows from Schaeffer and Shallit (2024); the sharp lower bound is the new part. External novelty and mathematical correctness have not been independently validated.
title: Exact dyadic string-attractor size of the powers-of-two indicator word
